decisions.decision: TECHNIQUE: Centrav B2B cabin restriction for international routes — single-cabin search avoids MCP timeout
decisions.rationale: RIC→PTY and RSW→PTY connecting routes with cabin:all exploded combinatorial space and timed out. Restricting to economy returned fast results.

decisions.decision: FIX: Centrav warm-ping changed from query_selector to locator.is_visible()
decisions.rationale: query_selector checks DOM presence (always true after page load). is_visible() checks actual visibility for real session state.

decisions.decision: AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE: Centrav B2B is primary air pricing source (9-69% cheaper than Amadeus consumer)
decisions.rationale: Domestic routes: 55-69% cheaper. International: 9% cheaper. Amadeus has no business class on domestic routes. Centrav is the authoritative source going forward.
